original_title: Disney claims the biggest box office opening of 2026 so far with Toy Story 5
summary_en: Disney and Pixar's highly anticipated Toy Story 5 has roared out of the gate, delivering the biggest box office opening of 2026. The beloved franchise installment shattered expectations, setting new records for both Disney and the Toy Story series.
ai_analysis: With Toy Story 5's massive opening, Disney proves the enduring power of its flagship animated franchises, setting a high bar for animated releases and showcasing a continued appetite for nostalgic, character-driven stories.

en.title: Toy Story 5 Shatters Box Office Records, Claiming 2026's Biggest Opening Yet
en.summary: Disney and Pixar's highly anticipated Toy Story 5 has roared out of the gate, delivering the biggest box office opening of 2026. The beloved franchise installment shattered expectations, setting new records for both Disney and the Toy Story series.
en.body:
The summer movie season officially has its runaway hit. Disney and Pixar’s **Toy Story 5** didn't just win the weekend; it *dominated* it, pulling in an astounding $160 million at the domestic box office. This figure not only makes it the biggest opening weekend of 2026 thus far but also sets a new franchise record, surpassing previous installments and cementing its status as a cultural touchstone for generations of fans.

Globally, the numbers are equally impressive, with **Toy Story 5** raking in $312 million worldwide in its debut. While Disney’s claim to the “biggest opening” has faced some scrutiny due to adjusted metrics compared to other releases like *The Super Mario Galaxy Movie*, the sheer force of **Toy Story 5**’s performance is undeniable. It comfortably outpaced the competition, with the weekend’s second-highest earner, **Disclosure Day**, managing only $17 million, a significant drop from its prior week's performance. Other newcomers like the Australian horror film **Leviticus** and **The Death Of Robin Hood** landed in the lower half of the top ten, highlighting **Toy Story 5**’s overwhelming success.

## A Franchise Reinvigorated

This monumental opening is a testament to the enduring appeal of Woody, Buzz, and the entire gang. After years away, the return to Andy's toy box has clearly resonated deeply with audiences worldwide. The film's ability to not only meet but exceed the massive expectations placed upon it speaks volumes about the creative team's dedication to preserving the heart and soul of the franchise while introducing it to a new generation. It also ranks as the second-highest animated opening weekend of all time, a remarkable achievement in today's crowded cinematic landscape.

## What This Means for Fans

For dedicated fans, **Toy Story 5**’s success is more than just a box office win; it's a validation of their enduring love for these characters and stories. It signals a strong future for the franchise, potentially opening the door for further adventures or spin-offs. The massive turnout suggests that audiences are eager for more heartfelt, character-driven narratives, especially from beloved brands they grew up with. The stakes were high for this sequel, and its triumphant debut reassures fans that the magic of **Toy Story** is far from over.

## What's Next

With this record-breaking start, all eyes are on **Toy Story 5**’s continued box office trajectory and its potential to become one of the year's highest-grossing films. Further details regarding potential future installments or related projects have not yet been announced.

tr.title: Toy Story 5 Rekorları Kırarken 2026'nın En Büyük Açılışını Yapıyor
tr.summary: Disney ve Pixar'ın uzun süredir beklenen Toy Story 5 filmi, 2026'nın en büyük açılışını yaptı. Sevilen franchise, beklentileri aştı ve hem Disney hem de Toy Story serisi için yeni rekorlar kırdı. Film, global olarak 312 milyon dolar hasılat elde etti.
tr.body:
Toy Story 5, yaz sinema sezonunun kaçırılmaz filmi olarak ortaya çıktı. Disney ve Pixar’ın **Toy Story 5** filmi sadece hafta sonu değil, tüm box office'i domine etti ve国内 olarak 160 milyon dolar hasılat elde etti. Bu rakam, 2026'nın en büyük açılış hafta sonunu gerçekleştirdi ve aynı zamanda franchise için yeni bir rekor anlamına geliyor.

Global olarak, **Toy Story 5** 312 milyon dolar hasılat elde etti. Disney'in "en büyük açılış" iddiası, diğer filmlerle karşılaştırıldığında bazı tartışmalara neden olsa da, **Toy Story 5**'in performansı inkar edilemez. Hafta sonu ikinci en yüksek hasılatı elde eden **Disclosure Day** filmi, sadece 17 milyon dolar hasılat elde etti. Diğer yeni filmler gibi **Leviticus** ve **The Death Of Robin Hood** filmi, ilk onda lower half'da yer aldı ve **Toy Story 5**'in ezici başarısını gösterdi.

## Bir Franchise'nin Yeniden Doğuşu

Bu açılış, Woody, Buzz ve tüm ekibin kalıcı çekiciliğini gösteriyor. Uzun bir aradan sonra Andy'nin oyuncak kutusuna geri dönmek, global olarak izleyicilerle derin bir şekilde rezonansa neden oldu. Filmin, sadece beklentileri karşılamakla kalmayıp aşması, yaratıcı ekibin franchise'in kalbini ve ruhunu koruyarak yeni bir nesle sunma konusundaki bağlılığını gösteriyor. Ayrıca, tüm zamanların en yüksek ikinci animasyon açılış hafta sonunu gerçekleştirdi ve bugünün kalabalık sinema manzarasında önemli bir başarı anlamına geliyor.

## İzleyiciler için Ne Anlama Geliyor

Süper fanlar için, **Toy Story 5**'in başarısı, sadece bir box office zaferi değil, aynı zamanda karakterlere ve hikayelere olan sevgilerinin onaylanmasıdır. Bu, franchise için güçlü bir geleceğin sinyalini veriyor ve potentially daha fazla macera veya spin-off için kapıları açabilir. Büyük bir turnout, izleyicilerin, özellikle yetişkinliklerinde büyüdükleri markalardan, samimi ve karakter odaklı hikayelere olan isteklerini gösteriyor. Bu devam filminin bahsi yüksek olsa da, zaferi, **Toy Story**'in büyüsünün henüz bitmediğini gösteriyor.

## Sonraki Adımlar

Bu rekor kıran açılışla, tüm gözler **Toy Story 5**'in devam eden box office performansına ve potansiyel olarak yılın en yüksek hasılat yapan filmlerinden biri olmasına çevrildi. Gelecek потенциал installments veya ilgili projeler hakkında daha fazla ayrıntı henüz açıklanmadı.

content_raw: Sure, the start of summer movie season kicked off back in May with Memorial Day and the latest Star Wars movie, The Mandalorian And Grogu . That movie was not the runaway hit that Disney may have hoped for , but the company had another at-bat this weekend, and with the summer solstice, Disney got a real hit. Toy Story 5 opened with not just what Disney is calling the best opening of the weekend but of all of 2026 so far. The latest Disney Pixar offering opened to $160 million at the domestic box office and, per Deadline , made it to $312 million globally. However, the “biggest opening” claim comes with an asterisk after it; The Super Mario Galaxy Movie opened with $372.5 million in its first weekend, but it opened in more territories and on a Wednesday, and Disney’s math claims that when adjusting for those things, it comes out on top.  In any case, Toy Story 5 certainly came out on top of the weekend, with the number two spot going to Disclosure Day , which earned just $17 million, more than a 60 percent dropoff from its opening last weekend. Obsession , meanwhile, held pretty steady, adding another $14.2 million to its domestic tally; the film has now passed $333 million globally.  The other new releases to make it in the top ten in the United States this week were Australian horror movie Leviticus , which debuted at number eight with $2.7 million, and the brutal The Death Of Robin Hood , which debuted at number nine with $2.6 million.
